This only applies to that one ad-loading event and is already live today, so engineers monitoring system operations can see more about how ad requests are behaving without leaking other information.

ai.summary: Replaced Promise.withResolvers with manual Promise construction in packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts. The change removes reliance on the newer static method, ensuring compatibility with runtime environments lacking full ES2024 support. Scope limited to agent-runtime stream processing logic. resolveStreamDonePromise is now assigned via a side-effect during Promise instantiation.

eli5.text: When an assistant handles streaming output from a model, it needs to wait for that stream to end before finishing up. The mechanism that tracks whether the stream is done was switched to a more widely supported form of waiting, so it works on runtimes that don’t include the very newest JavaScript features. If you looked closely, you’d see the stream-ending logic now uses the basic waiting construct that all JavaScript environments understand instead of the newer convenience helper. The result for you is no change in behavior, just broader compatibility under the hood.

ai.title: Imprezia ad network integration added to common
ai.summary: Added a three-file Imprezia chat ads integration in `common/src/util/` (`ad-experiment.ts`, `imprezia-ad.ts`, `imprezia-client.ts`) implementing experiment bucketing, the server-to-server chat ad decision request, and beacon-backed impression reporting. The `adExperimentArmForUser` function uses FNV-1a hashing over `IMPREZIA_EXPERIMENT` and the user id to assign 10% of signed-in users to the `imprezia_first` arm, while `fetchImpreziaChatAd` POSTs to `/v1/ads/chat` with the publisher key in the `X-API-Key` header and routes sandbox keys (`api_pub_sandbox_`) to `IMPREZIA_SANDBOX_BASE_URL`. `impreziaImpressionFields` maps a decision onto impression-row columns and serializes a `ImpreziaBeaconRecord` into the `ad_impression.provider_meta` column so CLI and Desktop surfaces can report viewable beacons after the auction.
ai.evidence: Three new files added under `common/src/util/`: `ad-experiment.ts` exports `IMPREZIA_EXPERIMENT`, `IMPREZIA_EXPERIMENT_PERCENT`, `AdExperimentArm`, `fnv1a`, and `adExperimentArmForUser`; `imprezia-ad.ts` exports `IMPREZIA_INTEGRATION_VERSION`, `IMPREZIA_SANDBOX_BASE_URL`, `IMPREZIA_PROD_BASE_URL`, `IMPREZIA_LIMITS`, `impreziaBaseUrlForKey`, `isImpreziaSandboxKey`, `ImpreziaAd`, `impreziaImpressionFields`, and `buildBeaconPayload`; `imprezia-client.ts` exports `fetchImpreziaChatAd` and the `ImpreziaChatAdResult` type.
ai.unknowns: The diff adds the shared modules and tests but does not show the wiring that consumes them in the web chat route, CLI/Desktop ad provider, or auction endpoint.
